title: The Dispatcher's Overclocked Tugs
logline: An unaligned orbital tug dispatcher refuses to assist either side in a dockland gang war, hiding that both syndicates' assault skiffs were secretly retrofitted with illegal military thrusters inside his own family repair depot.

roles.description: Chief scheduler of the station's commercial maneuvering tugs; tired, defensive, and protecting a compromised family shipyard.
Leader of the lower-berth protection racket demanding exclusive tug towing rights to stage a dock invasion.
Commander of the rival freight hijackers determined to incinerate the dispatcher's depot for supplying their enemies.
A reinforced industrial tug retrofitted with military burn-injectors and prow ramming spikes.
A high-speed raider skiff armed with repeating plasma cannons and tractor disruption nets.
A cluttered maintenance dock where heavy maneuvering tugs are refitted and fueled.
The narrow orbital traffic lane connecting the container berths to the main station airlocks.
A loose alliance of dock gangs and scrap pirates vying for territorial control of station freight lanes.

public_situation: Armed tug skiffs trade missile fire outside {role:crossroads_transit_channel} as rival dock gangs wage a bloody territorial turf war over cargo handling rights.
private_truth: {role:tug_dispatcher} sold black-market military fuel injectors to both gangs to pay off his brother's gambling debts, and now both crews are flying ships modified by his own wrenches.

beats.public_change: Commercial tug traffic freezes across {role:family_tug_depot} as rival gangs establish blockades outside the transit channel.

missions.reason: He pays the pilot to intercept an uncrewed drifting scrap barge and recover a dropped high-output injector manifold before port marshals scan it.
missions.private_fact: The manifold has his family depot's serial stamp etched into the titanium intake housing.

beats.public_change: {role:modified_assault_skiff} powers into the transit channel, firing heavy cannons at rival cargo berths.

missions.reason: He hires the pilot to disable the rampaging assault skiff before it rams the main fuel storage silos.
missions.private_fact: He knows that if the skiff explodes against the silos, port investigators will trace the ignition failure back to his tuning logs.

beats.public_change: {role:rival_syndicate_captain} surrounds the family repair depot with armed gunboats, demanding the dispatcher hand over master engine kill-codes.

missions.reason: He begs the pilot to rush an emergency cryptographic bypass key to his family dock master terminal before the gang breaches the airlocks.
missions.private_fact: The bypass key will remotely freeze the engines on both gangs' ships, exposing that he had a backdoor switch installed all along.

beats.public_change: {role:outlaw_gunboat} prepares to launch torpedoes into the depot as the overboss's squadron rallies for a final battle.

missions.reason: He hires the pilot to disable the attacking gunboat so his family can evacuate their dock berths in an unpressurized cutter.
missions.private_fact: The rival captain hails mid-fight offering a massive slice of dock extortion profits if the pilot hands over the dispatcher's bypass codes.

player_choice.prompt: With the kill-codes ready and both fleets stalled, the pilot must decide whether to freeze both fleets, sell the codes to the mob, or protect the dispatcher's neutrality.

options.label: Broadcast the kill-codes to shut down both gangs' thrusters and end the dock war
Sell the kill-codes to the rival captain to let them wipe out their enemies
Destroy the codes and escort the dispatcher's family into unaligned space

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot broadcasts the kill-codes, shutting down all thrusters.
resolutions.summary: Port marshals board and arrest both gangs. {role:tug_dispatcher} is arrested alongside the gangsters for illegal arms trafficking, ending his family's century-old business.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot triggered remote engine kill-codes, paralyzing two warring dock gangs and exposing a corrupt tug dispatcher.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot sells the kill-codes to the rival captain.
resolutions.summary: {role:rival_syndicate_captain} shuts down the overboss's ships and massacres the crew. The victorious gang establishes total control over cargo traffic in {system}.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot sold tug kill-codes to mob pirates, handing control of the station's commercial lanes to ruthless killers.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot escorts the dispatcher's family into deep space.
resolutions.summary: {role:tug_dispatcher} escapes into the rim, abandoning the depot. Both gangs tear the docks apart in an unresolved blood feud, closing transit lanes.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot helped a crooked dock dispatcher flee into deep space after his illegal engine mods ignited a station gang war.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot never intervenes or abandons the depot.
resolutions.summary: Gang torpedoes breach the fuel tanks, incinerating {role:family_tug_depot} and gutting the dispatcher's livelihood. The cargo lanes remain closed under smoking debris as he is driven into exile.

loose_threads.detail: The assault tug's burn-injector manifolds bear serial numbers traced to a commercial tug manufacturer that filed bankruptcy two years ago.
Defaulted gambling markers registered in the dispatcher's brother's name were bought up by an off-system debt recovery trust.

radio_hooks: Tugboat collision closes primary commercial approach lane outside cargo ring.
Station port marshal threatens total curfew following armed skirmishes between rival loader crews.
Freight shipping insurance premiums spike across {system} as harbor tug services halt.

voice_direction.tug_dispatcher: Tired, hoarse, and speaks in a strained, gravelly rumble. Sounds like a working man drowning in consequences he never planned for.
voice_direction.overboss_enforcer: Loud, vulgar, and speaks with menacing theatrical bravado. Treats violence as an ordinary cost of business.
voice_direction.rival_syndicate_captain: Hissing, intense, and speaks in clipped street threats. Consumed by visceral hatred for his rivals.
